info.title: The Estimator preview APIs
info.description: Versioned contracts for the Next.js preview BFF, Python document-intake and agent-analysis service, and Go estimator. Local preview persistence is opt-in; private records use first-party account sessions and require identity, service authentication, PostgreSQL, and encryption configuration.

get.description: The web app reports readiness after both preview APIs pass health checks. Python reports its parser; Go reports its engine version.

post.summary: Analyze a client request and return a reviewable scope without estimating it
post.description: Next.js BFF. Accepts pasted text or supported files and returns source-linked analysis. The estimator is not called until the reviewer confirms the edited scope through /api/v1/preview/estimate.

200.description: Extracted source, agent steps, and editable findings. No effort estimate has been calculated.

400.description: Malformed input or invalid parser/capability fields.

413.description: JSON request or uploaded file exceeds its size limit.

415.description: Unsupported request content type or uploaded file type.

422.description: A downstream service rejects the request or no reviewable work items were extracted.

503.description: AI is unavailable, or the analysis service is unavailable or timed out.

post.summary: Analyze pasted text for source-linked work scope, missing information, and capabilities
post.description: Python FastAPI endpoint. Accepts 30 to 20,000 characters and an optional team capability profile. Sample rules are local; AI mode runs a bounded specialist-agent analysis and verifies source evidence.

200.description: Source-linked scope, risks, capability findings, analysis trace, and source metadata.

422.description: Invalid request fields or unsupported parser.

503.description: AI mode is not configured or the provider permissions are unavailable.

504.description: Brief analysis exceeded the bounded request deadline.

502.description: The model provider or structured analysis failed.

post.summary: Estimate integration effort from a reviewed scope
post.description: Go estimator endpoint. The request body is limited to 1 MiB. Go JSON decoding rejects unknown object fields. historyPolicy defaults to demo and supports demo or recorded.

200.description: Task-level effort, planning range, assumptions, matched examples, and provenance.

400.description: Malformed JSON, unknown JSON fields, or a request body that cannot be decoded.

422.description: Invalid answers, history policy, requested requirement category, or exclusion category.

503.description: Estimate exceeded the bounded request deadline.

post.summary: Extract and analyze a supported client document
post.description: Python FastAPI multipart endpoint. Reads PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, CSV, TXT, Markdown, JSON, and EML files locally, with a 10 MiB upload limit and bounded extracted text. Scanned PDFs without text are rejected with a clear extraction error.

200.description: Extracted document metadata and the same reviewable analysis result as pasted text.

413.description: Upload, archive expansion, or page count exceeds the bounded limit.

422.description: Unreadable, malformed, scanned, or invalid document or request fields.

502.description: The model provider or structured analysis failed.

503.description: AI mode is not configured or the provider permissions are unavailable.

504.description: Document analysis exceeded the bounded request deadline.

post.summary: Create an explicitly uncalibrated general-work planning range
post.description: Go estimator endpoint for non-integration work packages. It maps human-reviewable small/moderate/complex bands to documented planning priors; it does not use synthetic or recorded delivery calibration.

200.description: Work-package planning ranges, assumptions, and uncalibrated provenance.

400.description: Malformed JSON, unknown JSON fields, or a request body that cannot be decoded.

422.description: Invalid work package count, title, ID, or complexity band.

503.description: Estimate exceeded the bounded request deadline.

post.summary: Estimate only after explicit scope review and confirmation
post.description: Next.js BFF. Requires reviewConfirmed=true, at least one reviewed work item, a supported estimate path, and exact evidence quotes found in the extracted source. Routes integrations to the integration estimator and other work to the explicitly uncalibrated general estimator.

200.description: Planning estimate for the explicitly confirmed scope.

400.description: Missing explicit scope confirmation or malformed JSON.

413.description: Confirmation payload exceeds its bounded size.

422.description: The reviewed scope is invalid or a source quote cannot be verified.

503.description: Estimator service is unavailable or timed out.

identitySession.name: estimator_session
identitySession.description: HttpOnly first-party session cookie; Secure is set for HTTPS requests.

nextAuthSession.name: next-auth.session-token
nextAuthSession.description: Temporary legacy OIDC session cookie used only for explicit workspace migration.

serviceToken.description: Short-lived BFF-to-Go HS256 token. The protected header includes a key ID for rotation; the token carries one operation-specific private-records scope and is never issued to browser code.
